title: Not-found page body
purpose: Fallback body for unknown paths: one short line and a link out to the live site.

content.budgetRule: Budgets are COUNTS measured from the rendered clone at 1440px (extraction/measured-values.json copyBudgets); copy itself is never stored. maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed across every route that renders this section; list sizes = observed min/max. Shorter is allowed; longer is rejected.

actions[].label.basis: max over measured units: paragraphs; list size from anchor count (no button-styled CTA measured)

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles (evidence); generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only, pinned in code). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog names only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values per section are listed in tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps.

retrievalIneligibleReason: Error/fallback state of the router, not designed page content; it links out to the live site and is never a generation target.
